verdicts.reason: A stacks the elements on three different axes: the logo is roughly centred, the headline is pushed left of centre, and the Shop button sits off to the right. Nothing aligns, the headline is undersized for the canvas, and the bottom-right area is empty. B keeps the original left-to-right logo, headline, CTA order at a legible scale with clear hierarchy and the brand colours intact; its only flaws are the Shop button sitting slightly close to the right edge and a lot of empty space above and below the single row.
